title: Stripe
statementMd:
Once Bob took a paper stripe of $*n*$ squares (the height of the stripe is 1 square). In each square he wrote an integer number, possibly negative. He became interested in how many ways exist to cut this stripe into two pieces so that the sum of numbers from one piece is equal to the sum of numbers from the other piece, and each piece contains positive integer amount of squares. Would you help Bob solve this problem?

## Input

The first input line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — amount of squares in the stripe. The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated numbers — they are the numbers written in the squares of the stripe. These numbers are integer and do not exceed 10000 in absolute value.

## Output

Output the amount of ways to cut the stripe into two non-empty pieces so that the sum of numbers from one piece is equal to the sum of numbers from the other piece. Don't forget that it's allowed to cut the stripe along the squares' borders only.
statementZhMd:
<statement>

Bob 有一条由 $*n*$ 个方格组成的纸条（纸条的高度为 1 个方格）。他在每个方格中写下一个整数，这些整数可能为负数。他想知道，有多少种切割这条纸条的方法，使得切割后两部分中的数字之和相等，并且每部分都包含正整数个方格。请你帮助 Bob 解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示纸条中的方格数。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的数字，表示方格中写下的数字。这些数字均为整数，且绝对值不超过 10000。

## 输出格式

输出将纸条切割成两个非空部分，且两部分中的数字之和相等的方案数。注意，只允许沿方格的边界进行切割。
</statement>
